eyebrow.content: Design & Analysis of Algorithms / Research Paper

paperTag.content: S.Y. B.Sc. Data Science — Semester III

subtitle.content: Recurrence relations, recursion trees, substitution, and recursive complexity

objective.content: To explain how recursive algorithms are structured, and how their time and space requirements can be analysed mathematically as input size grows.

rows.question: What is the main objective of your research?
rows.answer: To study how recursive algorithms work and how their efficiency can be expressed mathematically, so that time and space behaviour can be compared independently of any particular machine.

rows.question: Why does algorithm efficiency need to be studied?
rows.answer: Because a correct solution is not automatically a usable one. Two methods solving the same problem can differ sharply in running time and memory once the input becomes large.
